 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    blocks = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 2 for rr in (r, r + 1) for cc in (c, c + 1)):
                if (r, c) not in blocks:
                    blocks.append((r, c))
                    for rr in (r, r + 1):
                        for cc in (c, c + 1):
                            out[rr][cc] = 2

    for r, c in blocks:
        # The four diagonal markers send rays away from the 2x2 block;
        # their colors cycle clockwise between the four rays.
        nw = (r - 1, c - 1)
        ne = (r - 1, c + 2)
        sw = (r + 2, c - 1)
        se = (r + 2, c + 2)
        rays = [
            (nw, -1, -1, grid[sw[0]][sw[1]]),
            (ne, -1,  1, grid[nw[0]][nw[1]]),
            (sw,  1, -1, grid[se[0]][se[1]]),
            (se,  1,  1, grid[ne[0]][ne[1]]),
        ]
        for (sr, sc), dr, dc, color in rays:
            rr, cc = sr, sc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += dr
                cc += dc
    return out
